sources.title: Swelling and shrinking soils
sources.verified_claim: BGS identifies shrink-swell as a major geohazard, especially in south-east Britain, and notes local behaviour depends on geology, moisture, trees, drainage and foundations. London-wide susceptibility is not a candidate-site result.

sources.title: GeoIndex (onshore)
sources.verified_claim: GeoIndex provides boreholes, geology, faults, 3D urban models and hazards, while BGS gives no warranty as to completeness of free map data. Viewer capability is not proof that the sample coordinates were queried.

sources.title: BGS GeoSure: shrink–swell
sources.verified_claim: GeoSure shrink-swell is a 1:50,000 hazard-potential dataset for local-level use. Hazard potential still requires an exact spatial match and site investigation for project decisions.

sources.title: BGS Geology 50K
sources.verified_claim: BGS Geology 50K provides generalised local-to-regional geology at 1:50,000 scale. Geological polygons are context and not a geotechnical investigation of a candidate.

sources.title: Shallow geohazards
sources.verified_claim: BGS lists shallow hazards such as shrink-swell, compressible ground, running sand, soluble rocks and ground gases. Presence must be established spatially and cannot be assumed from the borough alone.

sources.title: GeoClimate Shrink–Swell
sources.verified_claim: GeoClimate models changing shrink-swell susceptibility under climate projections. It is hazard-susceptibility evidence, not a prediction of damage at a specific sample parcel.

sources.title: UK Radon Map
sources.publisher: UK Health Security Agency / British Geological Survey
sources.verified_claim: The indicative atlas simplifies radon potential by 1-km grid while the detailed dataset is the definitive affected-area map. Free-map class is not a property measurement.

sources.title: UK maps of radon
sources.verified_claim: UKHSA states the free radon map is not a substitute for an address-specific search and should not be used for basements or underground sites. Exact property radon status remains unbound.
